In Winter 2021 I taught a semester-long course at UWO on Algebraic Topology, aimed at
graduate students and upper-level undergraduates.

The nominal textbook was [Hatcher](http://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/ATpage.html), though I
rarely used it. The course covers the fundamental group, covering spaces, and singular homology.
